overall_notes: The paper focuses on enhancing in-context learning ability through pre-training on intrinsic tasks. NLG evaluation is conducted primarily on the Super-NaturalInstructions benchmark using ROUGE metric. Text classification tasks (SST-2, SST-5, etc.) are also evaluated but these are not NLG tasks. The extraction was generally accurate but needed some task normalization and removal of non-NLG tasks.
